_note: For an Authorized Person or Registered Architect to mark work that deterministic scoring cannot assess. Drafted without professional review: see issue #14. Scores stay separate from the ArchBench verdict.

scale.1: Weak: a professional would redo it

criteria.name: Site and context
criteria.ask: Does the scheme respond to the street, neighbours, orientation, views and microclimate? Are constraints used, not just listed?

criteria.name: Spatial judgement
criteria.ask: Do layout, circulation, section and proportions work for the people using them? Are the trade-offs sensible?

criteria.name: Regulation in the design
criteria.ask: Are escape, access, barrier-free and GFA matters resolved in the layout, rather than only reported in a separate check?

criteria.name: Drawing standard
criteria.ask: Are the drawings legible, consistent, correctly annotated and at a suitable scale? Could a colleague develop them?

criteria.name: Written communication
criteria.ask: Is the statement clear to its reader, specific to this scheme, and honest about assumptions and open questions?

criteria.name: Professional judgement
criteria.ask: Does the work raise the right risks, know its limits and say when an AP, consultant or client decision is needed?
